scope: Publicly accessible portfolio; user branding, artwork, portrait and CMS content retained.

observations.implementation: Eight double-sided cards; per-card height, depth opacity and stacking; masked portrait center; 30fps transform updates; paused offscreen/hidden; reduced-motion support.
Fixed pill navigation, live Karachi clock, Works/Shop/Contact; right-aligned vertical mobile menu; Escape closes it.
Seamless 78-second client-name/logo marquee from user CMS; hover/focus pause.
Animated exclusive accordion, alternating 72-second image marquees, image links and service details.
Two opposite-direction 56-second image marquees, hover links to existing case studies.
Four alternating moving rows using existing project images; collapsible category/garment/year/search/sort filters; empty-state recovery.
Moving user-provided testimonial cards; client-story count replaces unverified reference ratings.
CMS-derived counts animate on first visibility; reference business claims are not copied.
Sticky statement with reversible word-by-word scroll highlighting.
User portrait with four cross markers and difference-blend text marquee at measured 18-second duration, -8-second phase.
Email/WhatsApp/inquiry and directory links, scroll-revealed blue brand panel, back-to-top and quick inquiry controls.
User published products in active collections, collection filters, photo viewer and product inquiry links.

verification.desktop: Hero motion and font, accordion state, work-row directions, no broken images or runtime errors.
verification.mobile: 390px viewport: vertical menu, Shop navigation, product photo viewer and Escape close, portfolio search with image preservation, no horizontal overflow, inquiry required-field validation, blue footer reveal.
verification.not_verified: Reference Shop and Contact destinations expose access-code-protected Private Preview screens; their internal behavior could not be inspected. No claim of equivalence is made for protected features.
verification.build: npm run build passed after final changes (TypeScript and Vite).
verification.gallery_keyboard: Verified dialog labelling, Tab focus wrapping, Escape close and focus restoration.
verification.scroll_motion: Confirmed successive word colors progress from dark to light, signature transform changes over time at 18s/-8s timing, no missing optimized images, and no browser runtime errors.
